module: Migration of the "sidecar" files of the dynamic decal textures. Upgrades a sidecar from version 1 to version 2: removes the path field and replaces the (obsolete) sdf type with the boolean isSdfCompatible.
notes: Known texture types: greyscale=0, color=1, sdf=2 (obsolete), fillTexture=3.
Only the v1 -> v2 migration exists; data of another version is left untouched.

migrate.desc: Modifies the table in place: if data.version == 1, upgrades it to version 2 (path = nil, isSdfCompatible = (type == sdf)).
